models_evaluated: automated MRI tumour segmentation models (contrast-enhanced T1 and T2)

links.outcome: Neuroradiologist preparation time and MDM discussion time with versus without AI-generated reports
links.effect: Preparation took 2m54s with AI reports vs 2m36s standard per case. Discussion was shorter with AI, 1m15s vs 1m21s per case.
links.quote: However, the computer-assisted simulated MDM (CAS-MDM) approach significantly improved MDM efficiency, with shorter discussion times per patient (1m 15s (± 0m and 28s) per case) compared to standard simulated MDM (SS-MDM) (1m 21s (± 0m and 44s) per case).

screen.reason: The study tests the clinical workflow and meeting efficiency impacts of integrating automated AI tumor segmentation and reporting into simulated multidisciplinary meetings compared to standard review.

primary.practice: AI-assisted multidisciplinary team reporting and workflow integration
